title: Antimatter Dark Matter
definition: Antimatter is the mirror image of ordinary matter with opposite charge, while Dark Matter is a hypothetical form of matter that does not emit, absorb, or reflect light, accounting for ~85% of the universe's matter.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Science & Tech (Prelims) regarding space missions, particle physics experiments (CERN), and the fundamental composition of the universe.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Antimatter Dark Matter.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
